subject: general
question: A financial assistance of_______ rupees will be given to the community health centres so that they can be strengthened to meet the standards of sanitation, hygiene and infection control under the 'Swachh Swasth Sarvatra’.
solution:
The Correct answer is__** 10 lakh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Swachh SwasthSarvatra,' **an inter-ministerial cooperative project of the** Ministries of Drinking Water and Sanitation and Health and Family** **Welfare,Secretary, Ministry of Drinking Water and Sanitation.**
 
• The Ministry of Drinking Water and Sanitation has certified approximately 700 blocks as Open Defecation Free under this campaign (ODF).
 
• Community Health Centres (CHCs) across the country'**s ODF blocks would get Rs 10 lakhs under the National Health Mission (NHM) t**o focus on sanitation and hygiene.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Each district receives one** Primary Health Centre (PHC**) for meeting quality requirements such as sanitation and hygiene.
 
• The initiative's goal is to build on and harness the accomplishments of two complementing programmes**, Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM) and Kayakalp.**
 
• Under** SBM,** the Gram Panchayat in which the PHC granted **under Kayakalp** for that district will be recognised, and special attention will be paid to making it ODF as soon as possible.
